images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Ranch houses

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a long rambling 1940s-50s ranch with a stone chimney, an arched entry porch and awnings, a wing and a detached garage, among tall woods behind a split-rail fence on a big wooded lot

why.note: the split-rail fence: the 'country' edge of the wooded suburban lot
